# Vladimir Haltakov

Vladimir Haltakov is a software engineer and founder based in Munich. His work focuses on artificial intelligence, computer vision, machine learning, developer tools, and independent software products.

## Main pages

- [About Vladimir Haltakov](https://haltakov.com/about)
- [Projects by Vladimir Haltakov](https://haltakov.com/projects)

## Agent interaction

The homepage exposes two WebMCP tools to visiting browser agents:

- `ask_vlad` asks Vlad's maintained site agent one focused question and preserves Vlad's conversation context across calls.
- `show_interest_summary` renders a personalized “Why Vlad is interesting to you” report after the visiting agent has connected its own knowledge of the visitor with Vlad's answers.
